name: honua-ai-representative-eval-corpus
description: Versioned, representative regression corpus for Honua's AI across two surfaces: Studio (8 generation capabilities) and DevOps (operator tool surface). This is the permanent regression harness referenced by the AI architecture plan (eval + example-library + gap-finder). The corpus DEFINITION uses no AI; only a bounded sample RUN calls a model. It complements (does not replace) the deterministic multi-model operator-eval lanes in eval/model-matrix.json, which gate releases against honua-server's server-side eval report.

scenarioSchema.capability/operation/operationArea: Capability or operation grouping the scenario stresses.
scenarioSchema.expected_behavior: Canonical outcome category: generated | needs-clarification | unsupported | description | diagnosis | analysis | proposal | changeset.
scenarioSchema.held_out: When true: eval-only. Never use for tuning, prompt few-shot examples, or the example-library.

heldOutPolicy: ~20% of scenarios per surface are held_out. Held-out scenarios are the regression tripwire and must never feed back into prompts, fine-tuning, or the example-library.

runPolicy.definition: Zero AI calls. `run_corpus.py --validate` only parses/validates/reports coverage.
runPolicy.sample: `run_corpus.py --run-sample` performs the BOUNDED measured run (<= ~30 model calls, no retries). It must not actuate any DevOps action and must not touch the live demo alias.
runPolicy.budget: Studio: ~2-3 scenarios per capability across the difficulty range. DevOps: ~4-6 scenarios. Total <= 30 Bedrock calls.
